name: GageHeight
description: One instantaneous value from the USGS National Water Information System, the gage-height series that the agency publishes for its surface-water monitoring sites. Derived from the usgs-iv feeder schema published in the xRegistry catalogue. The sample exists because the upstream record carries no statement of what was measured: the member is called `value`, and its meaning is supplied by the five-digit `parameter_cd` that a consumer must look up in the USGS parameter-code dictionary. Everything else that qualifies the number is also a code — a `timeseries_cd`, a list of one-letter `qualifiers`, and an `exception` drawn from a closed set of three-letter abbreviations. It demonstrates observedProperty carrying, in the schema, the meaning that the upstream feed defers to a code list, resultQuality over the qualifier letters that decide whether a value may be used in an analysis, and status over the exception codes that explain a missing reading.

QualifierEnum.name: QualifierEnum

description.e: Estimated by the analyst rather than read from the instrument.
description.<: The actual value is known to be less than the reported one.
description.>: The actual value is known to be greater than the reported one.
description.&: The value was affected by an unspecified condition.

QualifierEnum.description: USGS data-qualification letter. `P` and `A` are mutually exclusive; the remaining letters may accompany either.

ExceptionEnum.name: ExceptionEnum

description.Ice: The reading was affected by ice at the site.
description.Bkw: The reading was affected by backwater.
description.Ssn: The instant falls outside the seasonal period of record for this series.
description.Zfl: There was no flow at the site.
description.Rat: The rating for this site is still being developed.
description.Fld: The reading was affected by flooding.
description.Pr: The site is a partial-record site and does not publish a continuous series.
description.***: The value is temporarily unavailable for an unstated reason.

ExceptionEnum.description: USGS exception code explaining why no value is reported. The codes are not interchangeable: `Ice` and `Bkw` describe a physical condition at the site, `Eqp` and `Mnt` describe the instrument, and `Ssn`, `Dis` and `Pr` describe the operating regime of the series.

site_no.description: USGS site number identifying the monitoring location, from the `site_no` field. It is unique only within the publishing agency, so a stable join key is the pair of agency code and site number. The site is the location whose water surface this record describes.

datetime.description: Instant at which the gage sampled the water surface, from the `datetime` field. The upstream feed reports it in the site's local standard time with an offset; the publisher normalises it to a UTC-aware timestamp. Sites report on a fixed interval, most commonly every fifteen minutes, so a gap in the series is detectable rather than inferred.

value.description: Gage height in feet, from the `value` field. It is the height of the water surface above the local gage datum established for this site, not an elevation above a national vertical datum, so values from two sites are not comparable without the datum offsets published in the site file. The member is absent when `exception` explains why no reading exists.

qualifiers.description: Qualification letters attached to the reading, from the `qualifiers` field. The list decides whether the value may be used in an analysis: a value carrying `P` has not been reviewed and will change, a value carrying `A` has been approved and will not, and a value carrying `e` was estimated rather than read from the instrument.

exception.description: Exception code explaining the absence of `value`, from the `exception` field. It is present exactly when `value` is absent, and it distinguishes a reading the site could not take from a reading the site did not attempt.

parameter_cd.description: USGS parameter code for the series, from the `parameter_cd` field. Upstream this code is the only statement of what the number means: `00065` is gage height in feet, `00060` is discharge in cubic feet per second, `00010` is water temperature in degrees Celsius, and a consumer that does not resolve it against the USGS parameter-code dictionary cannot interpret `value` at all. The `observedProperty` annotation on this record states the same fact in the schema, so a consumer no longer has to.

timeseries_cd.description: USGS time-series identifier, from the `timeseries_cd` field. A site may publish several series for one parameter code — a primary sensor and a backup, or sensors at different points on the structure — and this code is what separates them. It carries no meaning of its own and is not resolvable against a published dictionary.
